description: Lists fishing waters (revíry) within a radius of a Slovak district town or of given coordinates, nearest first, with distance, water type, river, district and SRZ organisation. Give either city or both lat and lon.

city.description: Name of a Slovak district town, e.g. "Nitra", "Žilina", "Košice".

water_type.description: Optional water type: carp = carp waters, trout = trout waters, grayling = grayling waters, other = other.

name: waters_near
title: Fishing waters near a place
